releases.name: opencode-easel 0.1.1
releases.body:
Published to npm as `opencode-easel`.

Install:

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-easel
```

Changes: documentation now covers npm installation and updates; the package contents are unchanged from 0.1.0.

releases.name: opencode-easel 0.1.0
releases.body:
First public release.

- Six chart forms: `line`, `columns`, `bars`, `sparks`, `share`, `pie`.
- Inputs: JSON, CSV, TSV, SSV, Markdown/SQL tables, aligned CLI output, XML, local files and previous tool results.
- Automatic charts for Prometheus, Datadog and Grafana MCP responses.
- `/easel` panel: pagination, two-column fullscreen grid, per-chart form override, deletion.
- SVG export via `format: "svg"`.
